name: vault_status
description: Shows the vault root path and how many Excalidraw schemes it contains.

name: scheme_list
description: Lists vault-relative paths of all Excalidraw scheme files.

name: scheme_read
description: Reads an Excalidraw scheme as a logical graph: nodes are shapes with their captions, edges are arrows between them, labels are free-standing texts.

path.description: Vault-relative path of the scheme file, e.g. 'Excalidraw/RAG.md'.

name: scheme_create
description: Draws an Excalidraw scheme from a logical description: you list what exists and what connects to what, the server computes the arrangement, ids and bindings. THE DEFAULT CHOICE — use it whenever the point is the information rather than the picture: an architecture drawn from the code, a quick map of a system, a first draft to refine later, or any request that does not say how the drawing should look. The layout is guaranteed readable: groups become labeled areas packed into a grid, and nothing overlaps. When the composition itself has to carry meaning — lanes, a legend, emphasis, a deliberate arrangement — use scheme_draw instead. To rework an existing scheme, call this with the SAME path, overwrite=true and the FULL new spec — never invent a neighbouring file name.

path.description: Vault-relative path of the scheme file, e.g. 'Excalidraw/Payments.md'.

nodes.description: Nodes to draw; 'key' names the node for edges, 'text' is the caption, optional 'shape' is rectangle (default), diamond or ellipse. Optional 'group' stacks related nodes inside a labeled frame — prefer groups for schemes with more than ~8 nodes. At most 500 nodes.

key.description: Identifier used by edges to refer to this node.

text.description: Caption drawn inside the shape; use \n for multiple lines.

group.description: Optional group name, e.g. 'Clients' or 'Backend'. Nodes sharing a group are stacked vertically inside a labeled frame; groups are laid out as columns by dependency flow. Grouping keeps big schemes compact and readable.

strokeColor.description: Outline color as hex, e.g. #1971c2. Default #1e1e1e.

backgroundColor.description: Fill color as hex, e.g. #a5d8ff. Default transparent.

fillStyle.description: How the fill is painted: solid (default), hachure, cross-hatch or zigzag.

strokeStyle.description: Outline style: solid (default), dashed or dotted.

strokeWidth.description: Outline width: 1 thin, 2 default, 4 extra bold.

fontSize.description: Caption font size in px, 8 to 120. Default 20.

font.description: Caption font: excalifont (default, hand-drawn), nunito, lilita, comic, virgil, helvetica or cascadia.

edges.description: Directed connections between node keys, each with an optional label. Without groups, the columns all edges skip add up to at most 20000 — give big schemes groups. At most 2000 edges.

label.description: Text drawn on the arrow. Empty for no label.

color.description: Arrow color as hex, e.g. #e03131. Default #1e1e1e.

strokeStyle.description: Line style: solid (default), dashed or dotted.

strokeWidth.description: Line width: 1 thin, 2 default, 4 extra bold.

startArrowhead.description: Head at the source end: none (default), arrow, triangle, bar, dot or diamond.

endArrowhead.description: Head at the target end: arrow (default), none, triangle, bar, dot or diamond.

overwrite.description: Set true to redraw an existing file in place; the whole drawing is replaced by this spec. Without it an existing path is refused.

name: scheme_draw
description: Draws a scheme you compose yourself: you place every block, zone and label on the canvas, the server only renders it — measuring captions, generating ids, binding arrows and warning about overlaps. USE THIS when the composition itself carries meaning and automatic layout cannot express it: swimlanes per team or stage, nested or overlapping areas, a legend explaining what the colours mean, deliberate emphasis through size or colour, a boundary band, a radial or timeline arrangement — or when the drawing is meant to be presented (a status review, a report, a slide) rather than merely read. Also use it to polish a scheme that scheme_create laid out: read it back, keep what works, place the rest by hand. Canvas units are pixels: a block is roughly 200-450 wide and 70-150 tall, 60-120 of space between blocks reads well, and a zone needs about 60 above its first block for the title. Compose deliberately — this tool does nothing to save a careless arrangement. For an ordinary graph where any sensible layout will do, prefer scheme_create.

path.description: Vault-relative path of the scheme file, e.g. 'Excalidraw/Payments.md'.

boxes.description: Blocks with captions; 'key' names the block for arrows. At most 500 boxes.

key.description: Identifier used by arrows to refer to this block.

text.description: Caption drawn inside; use \n for multiple lines.

width.description: Width in canvas units; computed from the text when omitted.

height.description: Height in canvas units; computed from the text when omitted.

strokeColor.description: Outline color as hex, e.g. #1971c2. Default #1e1e1e.

backgroundColor.description: Fill color as hex, e.g. #a5d8ff. Default transparent.

fillStyle.description: How the fill is painted: solid (default), hachure, cross-hatch or zigzag.

strokeStyle.description: Outline style: solid (default), dashed or dotted.

strokeWidth.description: Outline width: 1 thin, 2 default, 4 extra bold.

fontSize.description: Caption size in px, 8 to 120. Default 20.

font.description: Caption font: excalifont (default, hand-drawn), nunito, lilita, comic, virgil, helvetica or cascadia.

zones.description: Background areas drawn under everything else — lanes, sections, highlighted regions.

title.description: Caption drawn inside the top-left corner. Empty for a bare area.

backgroundColor.description: Fill color as hex, e.g. #f8f9fa, or 'transparent'. Default #f8f9fa.

strokeStyle.description: Outline style: solid (default), dashed or dotted.

titleSize.description: Title size in px, 8 to 120. Default 20.

text.description: The text to draw; use \n for multiple lines.

font.description: Font: excalifont (default, hand-drawn), nunito, lilita, comic, virgil, helvetica or cascadia.

arrows.description: Connections between blocks, each optionally routed through explicit bends. At most 2000 arrows.

fromSide.description: Face of the source block the arrow leaves from: auto (default), left, right, top or bottom.

toSide.description: Face of the target block the arrow enters: auto (default), left, right, top or bottom.

bends.description: Corner points the arrow passes through, as [x, y] pairs in canvas units. Empty for a straight line.

label.description: Text drawn on the arrow. Empty for no label.

color.description: Arrow color as hex, e.g. #e03131. Default #1e1e1e.

strokeStyle.description: Line style: solid (default), dashed or dotted.

strokeWidth.description: Line width: 1 thin, 2 default, 4 extra bold.

startArrowhead.description: Head at the source end: none (default), arrow, triangle, bar, dot or diamond.

endArrowhead.description: Head at the target end: arrow (default), none, triangle, bar, dot or diamond.

overwrite.description: Set true to redraw an existing file in place; the whole drawing is replaced. Without it an existing path is refused.
